svg.text: PROPOSED DEPLOYMENT — NOT INSTANTIATED IN THIS REPOSITORY
Reference deployment · AWS VPC
How the same record and the same six laws would run inside an enterprise. The demo proves the governance; this proves it can be operated.
OUTSIDE THE BOUNDARY
Desktop agents
Claude Cowork · Copilot · in-house
Authors write skill folders on their own
machines. No agent has canon credentials.
push a folder → CI → S3 (versioned)
Skill runtimes
ECS tasks · Lambda · laptops · agents
Wherever a skill actually executes.
every invocation calls POST /api/use first
Corporate IdP
Entra ID · Okta — SAML / OIDC
The OWNER column is a federated identity,
not a string somebody typed.
EDGE
Route 53 → AWS WAF → API Gateway
private REST API · mTLS · usage plans
Reached over PrivateLink from inside the
network, or Direct Connect from a plant.
rate-limited per calling skill, not per user
VPC · 10.40.0.0/16 · NO INTERNET GATEWAY · TWO AVAILABILITY ZONES
AVAILABILITY ZONE A
AVAILABILITY ZONE B
private-app · 10.40.1.0/24
private-app · 10.40.2.0/24
ECS Fargate — the thin app
app.py, containerised · autoscaled · stateless
Serves /api/state, /api/use, /api/promote,
/api/clear. Holds nothing. Delete it and the
record is untouched — that is the design.
ECS Fargate — the thin app
identical task definition · same image digest
An NLB spreads traffic across both zones.
Losing a zone loses no record and no
signature — only capacity.
private-data · 10.40.11.0/24
private-data · 10.40.12.0/24
Aurora PostgreSQL — THE CANON (writer)
nodes · edges · rules · exemptions · clearance · proposals
Single writer. Row-level security per team.
PITR 35 days. Encrypted with a customer-managed key.
canon.py is the single access layer — CSV in the demo,
Aurora here. One file changes, no other.
Aurora replica + DynamoDB (hot path)
skill → version · status · clearance expiry
/api/use must answer in single-digit ms at every
invocation across the company, so the gate reads a
projection. Aurora stays the system of record;
DynamoDB is a cache that may never be signed against.
private-inspection · 10.40.21.0/24
Lambda — the inspection
engine/inspect_skills.py · one loop, six checks
Reads each team's rules from the canon and writes a
verdict. It states no rule and names no skill.
NO NAT GATEWAY. NO INTERNET ROUTE. NO EGRESS.
The grader cannot reach a model or any third party —
not by policy, by routing. A verdict this record cannot
reproduce offline is not a verdict it will accept.
scheduler + workflow (regional, no subnet)
EventBridge Scheduler → Step Functions
one schedule per team — 90d, 45d, whatever it set
The sweep is triggered by the record, not by a person.
Step Functions fans out per team, retries, and writes
one run row per sweep to canon/runs.
A lapsed signature blocks a skill because nobody
renewed it — not because somebody remembered to
switch it off. That asymmetry is the whole control.
VPC ENDPOINTS — NOTHING LEAVES THE AWS NETWORK
S3 — the skill folders
gateway endpoint · versioning ON
One prefix per skill. Every version of every
folder, immutable and addressable.
OBJECT LOCK (compliance mode) on the
clearance register: a signature cannot be
edited after the fact, by anyone, including root.
Kinesis Firehose → S3 → Athena
the telemetry the benchmark grades on
Every call and every REFUSED call, with its
version and its caller, partitioned by day.
Glue catalogues it; Athena answers
"what should we retire?" over years of it.
Cheap to keep. Never the system of record.
Interface endpoints
KMS · Secrets Manager · CloudWatch · ECR
Every dependency the app has is reached
privately. There is no route to the internet
from any subnet in this VPC.
Egress is a decision somebody has to make
and sign for — not a default.
reads / writes the canon
gate reads the projection
NLB · both AZs
fires the sweep, per team, on that team’s own cadence
signs the register
streams every call
AWS ORGANIZATIONS — ONE ACCOUNT PER TEAM, ONE SHARED CANON ACCOUNT
A team is an account boundary
A team's apex maps to its own AWS account.
Its skills execute there; its blast radius ends
there. Cross-team dependencies cross accounts
through a resource policy — visible, revocable.
SCPs stop a team loosening its own apex rules.
IAM Identity Center
The owner column resolves to a real, current
person. When they leave, every skill they answer
for becomes STEWARDLESS on the next sweep and
stops running.
Offboarding becomes a governance event.
CloudTrail · Config · GuardDuty
Who called what, from where, with which role —
independent of the record's own logs, so the two
can be reconciled against each other.
Config rules alarm when a rule row is changed
outside the maker-checker path.
What this does NOT need
No vector database. No model endpoint. No GPU.
No third-party SaaS in the trust path.
The governance is deterministic, so the platform
under it is boring — and boring is what survives
an audit, a vendor change and a decade.
MERIDIAN INSTRUMENTS 子虛儀器 is an invented company. This diagram is a proposed target architecture and is deliberately not built in this repository — see the built-vs-suggested table in the README.
